title: B｜校園庭院・一起聽聲音
prompt:
Create ONE finished wide 16:9 landscape opening illustration for a Taiwanese science learning website, unit 3.3 Characteristics of Sound. No website UI, no border or captions. Warm richly painted anime storybook style, detailed honey-colored wood, cream clothing, soft golden daylight, clear inviting visual storytelling and expressive faces. This is a NEW unified scene, not a collage or infographic. Render the objects in the same painted illustration style as the characters, do not paste photoreal cutouts. Use attached image 1 as the EXACT character reference: Xiaokui has brown double-bun hair, natural wisps and bangs, brown eyes, cream hoodie with dark brown backpack straps. Grandpa has fluffy silver-white hair, round thin glasses, absolutely clean-shaven face, white coat over brown waistcoat and dark tie. Exactly two arms and two hands on each character, natural anatomy. Both whole heads and all main props remain within the central 90% of the frame.

The updated lesson has SEVEN learning blocks which the scene should naturally evoke together: tuning-fork vibration/amplitude, speaker frequency/pitch, guitar string length/tension, closed-bottom panpipe air-column length, different instrument timbres, human/dog/bat hearing ranges, everyday quiet/loud scenes. All candidates must show these FOUR recognizable primary apparatus groups, with breathing room: (1) a compact warm wooden cabinet speaker with a large black cone, resembling reference image 2, a clearly visible major foreground object; (2) a real acoustic wooden GUITAR with recognizable rounded body, sound hole, six strings and neck, resembling image 3, NOT a monochord string box; (3) SIX vertical bamboo panpipes of graduated heights bound together, resembling repeated tubes from image 4, OPEN at the top and CLOSED at the bottom, NOT horizontal metallic pipes; (4) a silver U tuning fork with exactly two straight prongs joined at a U and a slim stem, on or beside a small wooden stand, with a small rubber-headed striker nearby. One group may be actively used by a person, the others remain clearly visible.

Secondary hearing clues: a small friendly brown-and-white dog relaxed and attentive near the table, and an open natural-history book on the table with a recognizable EAR drawing on one page and a BAT drawing on the other. Bat stays a book illustration, not a bat flying in daylight. Everyday sound-level clues belong in the real background: a quiet reading spot and two distant people chatting, with a tiny distant yellow construction machine behind a safety barrier visible outdoors. These are background hints, not an extra story overpowering the main characters. Everything is a coherent believable school activity space.

IMPORTANT: No sound-level meter, no measuring microphone, no monochord box, no horizontal metal pipe rack, no film projector or movie equipment, no stage or grand piano. No computers, oscilloscope, waveform graphs, visible physical sound ribbons, floating icons, labels, text, numbers, equations, titles, logos, or watermarks. This picture introduces the actual instruments and exploration activities, without implying a real sound-level measurement. Prioritize hierarchy and readability at hero thumbnail size; do not cram seven separate panels into the scene.
COMPOSITION B: A distinctly different lively OUTDOOR SCHOOL COURTYARD exploration scene under a leafy tree and a cream canopy, warm dappled sunlight, school walkway receding behind. Xiaokui is seated LEFT holding and gently plucking a FULL ACOUSTIC GUITAR naturally across her lap; her two hands connect correctly to guitar neck and sound hole, body and strings prominent. Grandpa seated RIGHT smiles and cups one hand near his own ear while listening; his other hand rests on the tabletop. A large recognizable wooden cabinet speaker with black cone is placed on the near-right corner of the central wooden table, facing the viewer. On the tabletop between them are a silver U tuning fork upright on its small wood stand with mallet nearby, and a graduated six-tube bamboo panpipe set in a simple stand. Open illustrated ear-and-bat book lies in the near-left foreground, friendly small dog sitting beside Xiaokui's chair. In distant courtyard background, a quiet reading bench, two people chatting on a walkway, and a small fenced construction area with a yellow excavator far beyond the school grounds. Rich but organized, play and listening are the story, no exhibition posters. The characters interact warmly, distinct outdoor composition, all four equipment groups readable.
